title: YT Short Generator
tagline: This is an AI powered YT shorts generator for sharing info about Uniswap v4
description: This project is an AI-powered YouTube shorts generator specifically designed to create informative content about Uniswap v4. It automatically produces engaging, short-form videos that explain Uniswap v4's key features, improvements, and use cases in a format optimized for social media sharing. The tool can generate shorts covering topics like new pool types, hooks functionality, singleton design, and other v4 innovations, making complex DeFi concepts accessible to wider audiences through bite-sized video content.
how_its_made:
This project is built using a Python backend that orchestrates the entire video generation pipeline. The system uses AI text generation to create informative scripts about Uniswap v4 features, which are then processed through Google Translate's API to offer multilingual support for global reach.
Hedra, a video rendering framework, is used to programmatically create visually appealing shorts with animations, text overlays, and transitions. The project integrates with YouTube's API for direct publishing capabilities.
A particularly innovative aspect is the automatic content tailoring algorithm that analyzes trending Uniswap topics and adapts content accordingly to maximize relevance and engagement. The system also includes a feedback loop mechanism that improves future content based on performance metrics from previously published shorts.
